messages:
alex: FYI - Aurora POC running into two separate issues: (1) occasional 400s from our rerank endpoint with 'dims mismatch' in the logs, (2) intermittent 429s when they bump concurrent batches. Copying error and sample request below.

alex: log snippet: `ERROR [rerank] request failed: embedding dims 384 != index dims 512`

alex: sample payload they sent: `{"candidate_embeddings": [[...384 floats...] ], "query_embedding": [...384 floats...]}`

priya: @alex thanks. Are they sending a different encoder for embeddings vs index? Ask Aurora which encoder produced their index vectors.

alex: I asked - they said they used a legacy in-house encoder (pre-2024) for their stored index, and our SDK's embed endpoint (redwood-embed-1) for live queries. They didn't realize dims must match.

carlos: Heads-up — customer is also asking about Dedicated pricing if we need to reindex + private deployment for compliance. They flagged SOC2 and SSO in the security questionnaire.

maria: For the dims issue: short term we can offer a shim that accepts their 384 vectors and pads/truncates to 512 but that will change quality. Recommend reindexing with same encoder as queries.

priya: Agreed. Offer two options: (A) reindex with redwood-embed-1 to align dims (recommended), (B) run a conversion pass (padding/truncation) as a migration step and surface delta in quality tests. Which does Aurora prefer?

alex: Also their POC spikes cause 429s. They send lots of small batches concurrently. Error from logs: `429 rate_limit_exceeded: token throughput exceeded` — looks like per-API-key qps limit + token throughput.

priya: Can we temporarily bump their rate limit for the POC? I can open a support escalation. Need exact qps they attempted.

alex: They reported ~450 requests/s with batch_size=16 (embedding requests + rerank calls).

maria: If they move to larger batch sizes (e.g., 128) they reduce QPS but increase per-call latency and can hit batching size limits on the rerank endpoint. Our current max batch for rerank is 128 items. Also GPU memory can cause OOMs if many large batches concurrent.

carlos: From a pricing POV, Aurora asked for an estimate to run a re-index of ~12M docs (512-dim) and a short dedicated burst for the conversion + canary. Need a ballpark monthly committed price for Dedicated and a one-time professional services estimate.

priya: I'll coordinate with bizops. For immediate POC unblocking: we should (1) offer a temporary rate limit increase to 600 rps for 48h, (2) provide a migration plan for reindexing, (3) share a security questionnaire pack (SOC2, SSO, KMS integration notes).

ops-bot: Deploy note - opened escalation SE-2026-011 for customer Aurora rate-limit increase request. Assigned to priya. ETA 4h.

alex: I pushed a quick diagnostic endpoint they can call that validates embedding dims vs index dims before rerank runs. Snippet: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED"
  -d '{"index_id":"aurora-prod-idx","embedding_shape":384}'
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/validate-index```

priya: Good. I also attached the security pack to their SSO contact (email). I asked for a signed NDA before we share more infra diagrams.

maria: For conversion flow: propose MapReduce-style reindex: export stored vectors, run conversion (or re-encode) in worker fleet, write back. We can provide a script and an estimate for worker-hours.

carlos: Aurora asked whether we can do the reindex as a service if they can't run it. Please draft PS scope and ballpark $/hour.

priya: I'll get PS numbers from ops. For now priority is POC unblock: alex - can you share the validate endpoint URL + an example response so they can run pre-checks?

alex: shared above - example response: `{"ok":false,"mismatch_count":173,"expected_dim":512,"observed_dim":384}`

alex: Also suggested they try a small sample reindex of 10k documents using our CLI tool to measure quality delta. Sent instructions.

maria: Note: If they opt for conversion shim, we should record quality regression tests as part of Optimize so they can revert if scores drop.

priya: Next steps agreed: 1) temporary rate bump for 48h (priya) 2) run validate endpoint + sample reindex (aurora) 3) PS costing & Dedicated pricing (priya + carlos) 4) security questionnaire follow-up (priya).

carlos: I'll set a call with Aurora CSM tomorrow to walk through tradeoffs.

maria: If they want a quick mitigation script, I can paste a padding/snipping example (python) into the ticket.

alex: thanks all. tagging @aurora-team in the ticket and closing this Slack thread once escalation resolves. :thumbsup:
